channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Tue Nov 10 — Best S&P day since April; gas up seven percent
item.description: Stocks soar as oil crashes on Iran de-escalation hopes; Dec Henry Hub +7% near $3.21; CPI today with a December hike priced; Abu Dhabi Russia-Ukraine talks open.

item.title: Mon Nov 9 — Gas reclaims three dollars on cold risk, record LNG
item.description: Dec Henry Hub back above $3 on colder late-November forecasts, record LNG feedgas and falling output; EIA storage moves to Friday; Brent ~$96 extends worst week since 2020; jobs blowout tees up a December hike.

item.title: Fri Nov 6 — Worst market day since April; gas tops $3
item.description: S&P -4.4% as AI trade reprices post-election; EIA +77 Bcf miss, Henry Hub back over $3; Canada budget leans into pipelines; Brent set for worst week since Covid.

item.title: Thu Nov 5 — Gas firms on output drop ahead of EIA
item.description: December holds .91 as Lower-48 output slips; EIA expected +84 Bcf; Democrats sweep the midterms; Iran floats a 48-hour Hormuz reopening.

item.title: Wed Nov 4 — Democrats sweep Congress; futures whipsaw
item.description: Dems take House and Senate; futures -2.4% to +0.9% round trip; HH ~$2.90 on warm Nov; WSJ: US floats Russian gas via Ukraine; AB budget Thu.

item.title: Tue Nov 3 — Election day; oil whipsaws on Iran talks
item.description: Brent's 7.6% plunge on US-Iran talk hopes and the overnight Qeshm rebound; Dec gas at $2.86; Direct Energy's $1.89/GJ November rate; midterms, AMD and the earnings bar.

item.title: Mon Nov 2 — Gas steady at $2.90; record-early vortex split looms
item.description: December holds ~$2.90 after the +80 Bcf surprise; models forecast the earliest stratospheric warming on record, centered Nov 4; OPEC+ holds; Calgary sunny all week.

item.title: Fri Oct 30 — Alphabet's $500B stumble sorts the AI trade
item.description: AI sorting: Alphabet worst day ever, Amazon & Intel slide late, breadth rallies; EIA +80 ends tight-build streak; BoC aftermath; TTF >EUR100; sunny Halloween.

item.title: Thu Oct 29 — November expires at $2.817, December takes prompt; EIA day
item.description: Deep gas: Nov expiry +12c, Dec prompt $3.03; EIA consensus +75 Bcf; feedgas back above 20; Freeport trip; NGTL linepack slips; Fed holds, BoC hikes.

item.title: Wed Oct 28 — BoC hike eyed, Fed decides, Ras Tanura struck
item.description: Central-bank double-header: BoC seen hiking to 2.50%, Fed expected to hold; Houthi strike claim on Saudi's biggest refinery keeps Brent above $115; November gas expires at $2.66.

item.title: Tue Oct 27 — Anthropic files for Nasdaq IPO; BoC hike eyed
item.description: Anthropic files to list as ANT; Fed meets, BoC seen hiking to 2.50% Wed; gas at two-year low into Nov expiry; Brent near $116; TTF highest since 2022.

item.title: Mon Oct 26 — EQT buys Range as gas hits two-year low
item.description: EQT-Range $50B+ all-stock deal; Henry Hub ~$2.52 lowest since Oct 2024 into Tuesday expiry; GDSR withdrawal and Alberta's first cold week; oil eases on Iran diplomacy; Fed and BoC Wednesday.

item.title: Fri Oct 23 — AI rout deepens, oil knocks on one hundred
item.description: Nasdaq's worst day since June on AI funding fears; Brent through $114; gas shrugs off a 10th tight build; Calgary's 26-degree weekend swing.

item.title: Thu Oct 22 — Gas at four-week low into storage print
item.description: Nov HH ~$2.75 after 4 down days; 10th straight tight build expected; NGTL linepack rebuilding; Calgary's first snow; Brent 5-month high on Saudi attacks.
